_meta.purpose: Canonical Buffer GraphQL API schema for QNFO social dissemination. Read before any Buffer API call.
_meta.migration_note: Legacy api.bufferapp.com/1.0/graphql.json + createDraft mutation are DEPRECATED (404). Use https://api.buffer.com/graphql + createPost.

token_protocol.rule: NEVER hardcode the token VALUE inside a skill file -- store only the file path, read live every time.

diagnostic_401_protocol.rule: A SINGLE HTTP 401 is INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE the token is dead. Run the discovery diagnostic against BOTH https://api.buffer.com and https://api.buffer.com/graphql with the query below before declaring the token stale.
diagnostic_401_protocol.never_use_for_diagnosis: REST endpoints (api.bufferapp.com/1/*) -- Buffer Personal Access Tokens are GraphQL-only; REST always returns 401 even for a valid token, producing a false diagnostic.

step_2_channels.query: query { channels(input: { organizationId: "{org_id}" }) { id name service } }

channel_discovery.rule: NEVER hardcode channel IDs -- always discover live, they can change.

input_fields.text: string, required -- Twitter limit ~410 raw chars (Buffer shortens URLs to ~23 chars, effective ~280 after shortening); Bluesky limit ~300 raw chars
input_fields.schedulingType: enum, required, UNQUOTED identifier -- use automatic (notification exists in schema but does NOT work for posting)
input_fields.mode: enum, required, UNQUOTED identifier -- one of addToQueue | shareNow | shareNext | customScheduled
input_fields.assets: array, REQUIRED NON_NULL -- always pass [] even when no media attached; omitting causes InvalidInputError
input_fields.saveToDraft: boolean, optional -- true for draft mode

create_post_mutation.response_query_pattern: mutation { createPost(input: {...}) { __typename ... on PostActionSuccess { post { id } } ... on InvalidInputError { message } ... on LimitReachedError { message } ... on UnauthorizedError { message } } }
critical_rules: Inline fragments on the PostActionPayload union DO WORK (a prior skill version's claim they don't work was FALSE and retracted -- the real bug was fragmenting on a non-existent type name).
ALWAYS request 'message' inside every error-variant fragment -- it contains the exact actionable text (e.g. queue-limit count), not just a bare __typename.
Enum values are UNQUOTED GraphQL identifiers: automatic not "automatic". Quoting causes 'Enum cannot represent non-enum value'.
LimitReachedError is a genuine account-level constraint (e.g. 10/10 scheduled posts), not an agent bug -- disclose as [BLOCKED: account queue limit], do not retry.

delete_post_mutation.response_pattern: mutation { deletePost(input: {id: "..."}) { __typename ... on DeletePostSuccess { id } ... on VoidMutationError { message } } }

post_format_template:
Title: <paper title>
DOI: <doi>
Paper URL: <papers.qnfo.org/papers/slug/>
Abstract: <1-2 sentence summary>
Hashtags: #QNFO #Research <domain-specific tags>
